t: JPL Terrestrial Reference Frame
s: Created through a square-root information filter (SRIF) and Dyer-McReynolds covariance smoother (DMCS) assimilating station position observations, Earth Orientation Parameters (EOPs), and local ties, JTRF2020 is a sub-secular, time series-based TRF whose origin is at the quasi-instantaneous Center of Mass (CM) of the Earth as sensed by SLR and whose scale is determined by the quasi-instantaneous VLBI and SLR scales.
